# Pull Request Review Checklist

Use this checklist when reviewing a PR to ensure consistency, clarity, and quality before merging.

---
# Pull Request Summary

 _Short description of what I observed_

### 🟥 Required Changes
   _These must be fixed before approval_

### 🟨 Suggestions
   _Optional improvements_

### 🟪 Questions
  _Clarifications needed_

### 🟩 Praise
  _Positive notes about design or implementation_


---

# Checklist
- [ ] The PR title and description clearly explain the purpose
- [ ] The PR is within the scope of the project
- [ ] Code is easy to understand, with clear logic
- [ ] Repeated logic is moved into reusable functions/helpers
- [ ] Code does what it claims to do
- [ ] Existing features still work correctly
- [ ] Tests pass locally or through CI
- [ ] UI matches design specs
